issues.problem: The note treats pra- as a possible slip of the typed text. prapakṣa is an attested word (the outer end / fore-part of a wing; MW cites it from this very text), so the draft must not hint at a typo. The referent of ubhayoḥ is also not discussed although the translation commits to 'both (schools)'.
issues.fix: prapakṣa = fore-wing (the outer end of a wing), an attested term of this text; not a slip. ubhayoḥ 'of both': the referent is not stated (the two schools of units 1-2, the two sides, or the two wings) and is left open. 'prakṛti' here = basic/primary form, not the 'constituent element' of the state. Array names kept in both languages: daṇḍa = staff (दण्ड), bhoga = snake (भोग), maṇḍala = circle (मण्डल), asaṃhata = loose array (असंहत).
